title: Acute Care Nurses
description: Provide advanced nursing care for patients with acute conditions such as heart attacks, respiratory distress syndrome, or shock. May care for pre- and post-operative patients or perform advanced, invasive diagnostic or therapeutic procedures.

tasks.text: Discuss illnesses and treatments with patients and family members.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical communication needs empathy and clinical accountability

dwas.name: Communicate detailed medical information to patients or family members.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Diagnose acute or chronic conditions that could result in rapid physiological deterioration or life-threatening instability.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests differentials; clinician examines and owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Diagnose medical conditions.

tasks.text: Perform emergency medical procedures, such as basic cardiac life support (BLS), advanced cardiac life support (ACLS), and other condition-stabilizing interventions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on emergency resuscitation and physical intervention

dwas.name: Treat medical emergencies.

tasks.text: Assess urgent and emergent health conditions, using both physiologically and technologically derived data.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment goals need clinical accountability and context

dwas.name: Analyze patient data to determine patient needs or treatment goals.

tasks.text: Set up, operate, or monitor invasive equipment and devices, such as colostomy or tracheotomy equipment, mechanical ventilators, catheters, gastrointestinal tubes, and central lines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Diagnostic instruments applied to patients by hand

dwas.name: Prepare medical supplies or equipment for use.
Operate diagnostic or therapeutic medical instruments or equipment.

tasks.text: Document data related to patients' care, including assessment results, interventions, medications, patient responses, or treatment changes.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Record patient medical histories.

tasks.text: Administer blood and blood product transfusions or intravenous infusions, monitoring patients for adverse reactions.
tasks.rationale: decision support — In-procedure patient monitoring is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Monitor patient conditions during treatments, procedures, or activities.
Administer blood or other fluids intravenously.

tasks.text: Interpret information obtained from electrocardiograms (EKGs) or radiographs (x-rays).
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Perform administrative duties that facilitate admission, transfer, or discharge of patients.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Healthcare forms processed digitally; human verifies edge cases

dwas.name: Process healthcare paperwork.

tasks.text: Obtain specimens or samples for laboratory work.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Invasive specimen collection needs hands-on clinical skill

dwas.name: Collect biological specimens from patients.

tasks.text: Manage patients' pain relief and sedation by providing pharmacologic and non-pharmacologic interventions, monitoring patients' responses, and changing care plans accordingly.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Post-surgical monitoring is hands-on clinical observation

dwas.name: Monitor patients following surgeries or other treatments.
Administer anesthetics or sedatives to control pain.

tasks.text: Collaborate with members of multidisciplinary health care teams to plan, manage, or assess patient treatments.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Assess the needs of patients' family members or caregivers.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Requires direct observation of patient environments

dwas.name: Assess patient work, living, or social environments.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Participate in patients' care meetings and conferences.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Treat wounds or superficial lacerations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on treatment of acute conditions

dwas.name: Treat acute illnesses, infections, or injuries.

tasks.text: Read current literature, talk with colleagues, and participate in professional organizations or conferences to keep abreast of developments in acute care.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes medical updates; human retains judgment

dwas.name: Maintain medical or professional knowledge.

tasks.text: Provide formal and informal education to other staff members.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

dwas.name: Train medical providers.

tasks.text: Collaborate with patients to plan for future health care needs or to coordinate transitions and referrals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical communication needs empathy and clinical accountability

dwas.name: Communicate detailed medical information to patients or family members.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Analyze the indications, contraindications, risk complications, and cost-benefit tradeoffs of therapeutic interventions.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment guidance aided; clinical accountability human

dwas.name: Evaluate treatment options to guide medical decisions.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Distinguish between normal and abnormal developmental and age-related physiological and behavioral changes in acute, critical, and chronic illness.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests differentials; clinician examines and owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Diagnose medical conditions.

tasks.text: Assess the impact of illnesses or injuries on patients' health, function, growth, development, nutrition, sleep, rest, quality of life, or family, social and educational relationships.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Functional assessment aided by data, exam human

dwas.name: Evaluate patient functioning, capabilities, or health.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Participate in the development of practice protocols.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts nursing policies; clinical board approves

dwas.name: Establish nursing policies or standards.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Assist patients in organizing their health care system activities.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Healthcare process guidance is largely informational

dwas.name: Advise patients on healthcare system processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Adjust settings on patients' assistive devices, such as temporary pacemakers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on fitting of prostheses to bodies

dwas.name: Adjust prostheses or other assistive devices.

tasks.text: Prescribe medications and observe patients' reactions, modifying prescriptions as needed.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids chart review; clinical observation of patient is human

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.
Prescribe medications.

tasks.text: Order, perform, or interpret the results of diagnostic tests and screening procedures based on assessment results, differential diagnoses, and knowledge about age, gender and health status of clients.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.
Order medical diagnostic or clinical tests.

tasks.text: Refer patients for specialty consultations or treatments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.
